josiascouper: Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper reported to S-F15 with his brother's pocket watch sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Magpie. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Magpie hit all three. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper watched where the shots came from.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Arno Olie of the Concord (@olie300).
peter_moodster__moodie: After 2 days of war, S-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 3, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Leopold Moodie.

Leopold Moodie and Bram Tephydraws argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. Now serving as a rifleman, Leopold Moodie discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Leopold Moodie of the Concord and Otto Elitecelebs of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near the Chalk Pits all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold Moodie went out with the wiring party at S-F19. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Moodie. Leopold Moodie read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
